common.preserve: physical parameters, stateless ridge-SR counter/damping/diagnostics, sampler configurations and RNG; no cold restart; old failure remains unchanged
common.acceptance: Fresh full-transition replay at tolerance2e-11, discrete exact, nonzero accepted physical updates, full1728-image coherentA1/all weighted H, memory<70GiB; fixed untouched audit independent of training/calibration.

next_stage.rule: Inspect first fixed endpoint and its uncertainty/variance, checkpoint integrity, mixing diagnostics and real H/SR wall time before registering longer stages or increased training samples. Do not treat an engineering128-record trajectory as a competitive N144 physical state.
